## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender girl who possesses milk-white skin and a pointed, pale face. She has glossy red hair, often styled in long braids or described as auburn and [Titian](../character/titian.md), paired with seven freckles across her nose. Her thin, skinny frame is complemented by a stylish appearance and a skinny body. She is further distinguished by her alluring, luminous gray eyes, which are occasionally described as serious, solemn, gray-green, or shining.

## Personality

Anne is an imaginative and empathetic individual who possesses a deep compassion for others, often feeling the pain of her friends so keenly that she struggles to find easy words of comfort. While characterized as smart, obedient, and quick to learn, she is also known to be heedless and impulsive, frequently acting or speaking without reflection. Demonstrating a love for children and a strong loyalty to conservative views in memory of [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), she is driven by a desire to add beauty to life. Her ambitions have included achieving high examination results for [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) and Marilla's sake and striving to win the Avery scholarship through hard work. In addition to a talent for gardening and a knack for reciting, she possesses a distinct skill for writing stories, including charming prize-winning works and pieces written for children.

## History

An orphan born in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) and raised outside Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island), Anne was brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) fourteen years prior to her marriage. Admitted to stay after an initial mix-up, she was brought up by [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and established herself in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) by founding the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and earning the entrance tied-first score for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). During her school years, she survived a drowning attempt on a pond when [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescued her, though she maintained a long academic rivalry with him. Anne later attended [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), where she declined a proposal from [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) via Jane and refused a diamond engagement ring, ultimately accepting a circlet of pearls when she became engaged to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Following their wedding, Anne moved with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), where she suffered the tragic loss of her firstborn daughter Joyce shortly after birth before later giving birth to a healthy son, [James Matthew](../character/james-a.md). In [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), she formed deep friendships with Captain Jim and [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), assisting in the events surrounding Captain Jim's life-book and Leslie's freedom from a mistaken marriage. After Captain Jim peacefully passed away, Anne and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) packed up their initial house of dreams and departed for a larger home in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary area.

> "Well, that is another hope gone. ‘My life is a perfect graveyard of buried hopes.’ That’s a sentence I read in a book once, and I say it over to comfort myself whenever I’m disappointed in anything."
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003)

> “Oh, what I know about myself isn’t really worth telling,” said Anne eagerly. “If you’ll only let me tell you what I imagine about myself you’ll think it ever so much more interesting.”
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne.md)

Anne first learns of Mr. and Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) upon their arrival in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and prepares an elaborate tea for them at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), which takes a disastrous turn when she accidentally flavors her cake with liniment instead of vanilla. Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) responds with immense kindness and comfort, winning Anne's affection immediately. Over time, the two become close kindred spirits, with Anne seeking comfort and spiritual guidance from her during difficult times.

- Friend of — kindred spirits and minister's wife  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006)</sub>

### [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--bertha-shirley.md)

[Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) is Anne's deceased mother, who died of fever when Anne was merely a baby. Anne grew up holding a deep emotional connection to her mother's memory despite never knowing her. Years later, during a visit to her birthplace in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), Anne receives a packet of her parents' old love letters, allowing her to feel truly linked to her mother at long last.

- Child of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)</sub>

### [Di](../character/di.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--di.md)

[Di](../character/di.md) and Anne are close friends and former schoolmates in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Their bond consists of shared childhood memories and long-standing companionship.

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--diana.md)

Anne and [Diana](../character/diana.md) are bosom friends who form an instant, passionate devotion to one another upon meeting. Their friendship endures severe trials, including a temporary ban by Diana's mother after Anne accidentally gets [Diana](../character/diana.md) drunk on currant wine, and the threat of separation when Diana's sister falls gravely ill with croup and is saved by Anne's swift care. Through school recitations, secret notes, and shared developmental milestones, they remain fiercely loyal companions.

- Friend of — close and affectionate friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--gilbert-blythe.md)

Anne and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) first meet at school, where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) sparks a long-standing grudge by pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots,' leading Anne to smash a slate over his head. This incident sparks a fierce academic rivalry throughout their school years, which eventually softens into a close, supportive friendship as they prepare for higher education together. Over time, their dynamic deepens through shared adult responsibilities and mutual romantic devotion, ultimately culminating in marriage.

### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--jane.md)

Jane is one of Anne's childhood schoolmates and a founding member of their creative story club. They collaborate closely in social efforts like the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and enjoy leisurely walks and picnics together. Their bond is built on shared youth, local community work, and lighthearted recreation.

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--leslie-moore.md)

[Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) is a beautiful, deeply tragic neighbor at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) whose bitter life circumstances initially cause her to hold a distant, envious reserve toward Anne's happiness. Their connection grows into a profound, fiercely protective sisterhood.

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--uncle-jim.md)

Captain Jim is an elderly lighthouse keeper at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) Light who immediately recognizes Anne as a 'kindred spirit.'
